snippet.title: LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy (2006) - GBA Longplay | Full Game Walkthrough No Commentary
snippet.description:
LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy is an action-adventure game developed by Traveller's Tales and published by LucasArts. Released in 2006, the game recreates the original Star Wars trilogy with LEGO characters, humor, platforming, puzzles, combat, and collectible items.

This longplay covers the complete LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy gameplay experience on Game Boy Advance, including story levels, characters, exploration, puzzles, enemies, and the full adventure with no commentary.
